$comment: Fixtures for scripts/probe-live.sh. Copy this to .github/merge-coordinator-probe.json in your repository and point every value at your own history. Only the probe reads this file; the landing scripts never do. Any key you leave out is reported N/M (not measurable), never PASS.
$comment_expectConfig: Written down by hand, not copied by a script: each config reader is checked against these. They must match .github/merge-coordinator.json.
$comment_mergedPr: A MERGED pull request: its file list can no longer change, so fileCount is fixed. Its head commit must be green on every required check. files names a few paths it touched.
$comment_noCheckCommit: A full 40-character sha from before any workflow existed, with 0 check-runs and 0 commit statuses. The repository's first week is the usual place.
$comment_footprintPr: A pull request whose body carries a footprint block of two or more paths. declares lists the first and last of them.
$comment_noFootprintPr: A pull request whose body carries no footprint block.
$comment_changelogMinBytes: A size the release-guard changelog is known to exceed, so a decode that returned a fragment fails. Optional; defaults to 1.
